Advancing Industry Since 1995

IAQ Group supports the world’s evolving industries through integrated engineering, construction and facility solutions. We combine technical expertise with disciplined execution to deliver facilities that perform today and adapt for tomorrow.

31 years of technical excellence through various service model with global presence across 7 countries

IAQ is a leading ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certified Malaysian owned company that delivers engineering and design consultation, procurement, construction, commissioning and testing, tool installation and maintenance services of plants and on-board project management services to client in diverse industries both locally and globally.

What IAQ stands for, and where it is going.
Vision
Where IAQ is going
To be a regional facility solutions provider with engineering excellence, facilitating technological innovation and advancement in quality of life.
Mission
What IAQ does every day
Providing innovative and sustainable facility and engineering solutions that benefit our clients and stakeholders, driven by our leadership, employees, and partners globally.
WHAT WE HOLD
Six values, held on every site.
1
Safety commitment
An injury free workplace where everybody goes home safe.
2
Quality consistency
The skills to bring excellence to your project, managed through an established QMS.
3
Honesty and integrity
Transparent communication of accurate information, with openness and sincerity in every interaction.
4
Engineering capabilities
An experienced multi-disciplinary in-house team, integrating technology and value engineering for advanced hi-tech facilities.
5
Efficiency and proficiency
Flexible fast-track execution and contractual approaches, fitted to the client’s needs.
6
Pursuit of excellence
Delivering on our commitments with the highest degree of engineering excellence.
